scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Quality Certification
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The unit must be a new or existing manufacturing or service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Commercial production must have commenced between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
The unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Certificates must be obtained from certifying bodies registered with the National Accreditation Board for Certification Bodies (NABCB)
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of issue of the certificate
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on certification fees and up to ₹10,00,000 (50% of testing equipment and machinery costs) as financial assistance
